features.title: Features
features.text: Discover how our app simplifies service management, boosts your agro operations, enhances event experiences, and makes connecting with others an easy task.

items.title: Instant connection
items.text: tap2link cards enable you to effortlessly exchange contact information and connect with potential clients or colleagues with just a simple tap, eliminating the need for traditional card exchange.
items.more: Gain a competitive edge by quickly exchanging contact information with potential clients or colleagues, making a memorable impression and staying ahead in a fast-paced business environment.

items.title: Club members solution
items.text: Created for all sport club memberships, fitness centres, private member clubs. Manage your members, prices & tiers, easily add newsletters and work with your partners.
items.more: Members can easily access VIP areas, enjoy exclusive promotions, and make seamless payments at club events. Plus, with personalised digital profiles, staying connected and up-to-date with club activities has never been easier.

items.title: Agro solution
items.text: Tailored to meet the unique needs of farmers and agricultural businesses. It simplifies the management of equipment and service requests, helping you stay organised and efficient in your operations.
items.more: You can easily track product information and access manuals, ensuring your machinery is always running smoothly. With Tap2link, connecting with service providers is just a tap away, making maintenance easier and faster than ever!

items.title: Service management
items.text: Designed to simplify your daily operations. It offers an efficient way to handle service requests, ensuring customer service runs smoothly in your company.
items.more: Thanks to QR stickers and scanniing them with tap2link app you can easily track and manage all your services in one place, reducing the hassle of juggling multiple tasks.

items.title: Event feature
items.text: Designed to transform how you manage gatherings, big or small. Create events, set ticket prices, send VIP passes, invite your co-workers. All in one place.
items.more: It allows for easy check-ins, so your guests can quickly get to the fun without the hassle of long lines. Plus, with options for ticketing, VIP passes, and seamless networking, you can create a memorable experience that keeps everyone connected and engaged throughout the event!

items.title: Apple & Google Wallet
items.text: Add your card to Apple & Google Wallet. This feature ensures that all your important information is conveniently accessible right from your smartphone.
items.more: By integrating your tap2link card into your digital wallet, you can make share contact details, create service request and check in at events with just a tap.

why.title: Why tap2link for heavy machinery retailers?
why.text: Tap2link offers a set of tools that allows your customers to quickly access support and order spare parts.

items.title: Centralized management
items.text: Manage customers and machines easily through a centralized dashboard.

items.title: QR-based ordering
items.text: Customers can order spare parts directly by scanning QR codes.
items.alt: An illustration of a QR code.

items.title: Machine tracking
items.text: Track the maintenance and purchase history of all machines.

items.title: Instant insights
items.text: Immediate access to machine-specific data and customer information.
items.alt: An illustration of a magnifying glass.

how.title: How it works
how.text: Tap2link gives you a fully customized profile and dashboard to manage all your customers and machines at a glance. By simply importing existing customers and machines via CSV, the system is ready to go. Your customers can order spare parts or request support with just one QR code scan.

steps.title: Import all machines and customers
steps.text: Easily upload machine and customer information via your designated dashboard.

steps.title: QR code support
steps.text: Customers scan a QR code to instantly access spare parts or request technical support.

steps.title: Automated information transfer
steps.text: All machine and customer data is sent directly to you, so you can respond efficiently.

steps.title: Dashboard overview
steps.text: Track which machines are with which customers, when they were last serviced, and how many machines each customer owns.

business.text: Enhance your contact management workflow in your company. Use tap2link to sail smoothly through the business world! NFC solutions for employee management and networking.

features.title: Features
features.text: Dive into tap2link features tailored just for your business needs. Networking never felt so easy!

items.title: One business card per employee
items.text: One business card is good for the environment and an excellent conversation starter.
items.more: Eliminate the need to print multiple business cards for each employee, saving costs on printing and ensuring consistency across the organisation.

items.title: Custom development of desired features
items.text: Tailor tap2link cards to your specific business requirements by implementing custom info and functionalities, specific to your field of business.
items.more: Be flexible, be up to date with all new market trends ensuring the cards align perfectly with your business processes.

items.title: Environmental friendliness
items.text: Embrace sustainability by replacing traditional paper business cards with eco-friendly tap2link alternative. Reduce waste and contribute to a greener future.
items.more: Traditional paper business cards contribute to environmental waste. By adopting tap2link business cards, you reduce paper usage, promote environmental responsibility, and demonstrate your commitment to a greener future.

items.title: Integrate your tap2link card with company’s CRM
items.text: Effortlessly connect your gained contacts with your company's CRM system to ensure seamless data synchronisation and enhanced customer management.
items.more: Managing contact information from traditional business cards and manually inputting them into a CRM can be cumbersome and prone to errors. tap2link automatically inputs contact data and ensures accurate and up-to-date customer information, saving time (money 😉) and improving overall CRM efficiency.

items.title: Manage all your employee profiles in one dashboard
items.text: Streamline employee profile management by centralising all profiles in a single, user-friendly dashboard.
items.more: NFC solutions for employee management and networking by simplifying profile tracking and accuracy—a common challenge for businesses. With tap2link, administrators gain access to an intuitive dashboard to manage and update employee profiles, ensuring consistent, up-to-date information organization-wide without the need to reprint business cards.

items.title: Custom design in the company style
items.text: Maintain a cohesive brand identity by customising tap2link card designs to align with your company's style and visual aesthetics.
items.more: Coherent branding throughout all the networking tools, from business card to employee profile, gives your potential business more insight into your brand’s identity.

items.title: Option to add your products to the company profile
items.text: Showcase your products or services directly on your company's tap2link profile. Create opportunities for promotion and lead generation beyond simple contact exchange.
items.more: Traditional business cards lack the ability to display products or services directly. tap2link cards provide the option to add product information, images, or links, giving potential clients a glimpse into what your company offers and fostering interest in your offerings.

items.text: tap2link allows us to provide customers with a seamless way to request service and spare parts for the machinery, while all interactions are being logged in our CRM. This is helpful not only for our sales team, but also to track and improve customer satisfaction. The adaptability of t2l to our specific needs was absolutely convincing!

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.text: Got questions? We have the answers! Go through our frequently asked questions to find information you're looking for.

items.a: In short, tap2link is a digital solution providing, fully customised online profiles containing contact information, SM links etc., as well as sustainable, multiuse, NFC-powered business cards.

items.q: What size should my profile picture and background be?
items.a: Both your profile picture and background should be crop to a square with the size ot exceeding 5 MB.

items.q: Does another person need an app to see my t2l profile?
items.a: No! And that’s the beauty of tap2link! All they need is a phone that can read NFC. It’s enough to just tap your card for the profile to pop up. In other case - you can also just share your profile’s custom url.

items.q: Do I have to pay for tap2link?
items.a: tap2link offers subscription plans but you can first try it out with a 3 day trial, completely free of charge.

items.q: Can I also open a tap2link profile without a tap2link card?
items.a: Yes, you can always create a free account without having a card. Simply share your t2l profile with via link or use it in your social media bio. As for the card - you can always buy it later.

items.q: Is it possible to get custom/individual card designs?
items.a: Yes! It’s possible to get a custom designed cards for larger orders. Just send us an email: support{'@'}t2l.ink.

items.q: Who can see my tap2link profile?
items.a: It all depends on your preferences. You can either set your profile as private and choose who you share it with, or make it public and share the url with the world (for example for SM purposes). You can always change your profile status in settings, both in the app and just by logging to your profile on t2l.ink.

items.q: Why can’t I connect my tap2link card to my digital profile?
items.a: If you have problems connecting your card, please first make sure that you have only one tap2link tab open in your browser. If you’re using tap2link on two or more tabs in your browser, this process will not work. If the connection still does not work, please contact us at support{'@'}t2l.ink and we will take care of the problem as soon as possible.

items.q: I lost my profile information, how can I get my profile back?
items.a: You can simply request a password reset using the forgotten password function. If you forgot which email you used for registration, please contact us at support{'@'}t2l.ink.

items.q: How long will I be waiting for my order?
items.a: Shipping time within Europe is typically 4-8 business days, depending on your location. Please contact us if you haven't received your order: support{'@'}t2l.ink.

items.q: My order did not arrive. What do I do?
items.a: After placing your order, it may take 7-10 working days for the order to arrive. If you have not received your tap2link card after 10 days, please contact us at support{'@'}t2l.ink.

You can return your t2l card within the first 30 days of the purchase. Ship it to: Donaustraße 36b, 41517 Grevenbroich, Germany. Please note that your order is subject to a 5 € restocking fee once the card has been activated. We’re sorry, this is due to a manual resetting process. The difference will be refunded to you.
If you wish to cancel your order, please contact us at support{'@'}t2l.ink. If your order has already been shipped, you can return your card within the first 30 days.
